candidates.name: Malrotation of the intestine
support_spans: an abnormally low transverse colon and right colic flexure, with small-bowel loops clustered above and to the right
The third portion of the duodenum was not seen in its expected location
candidates.why: The patient's symptoms and imaging findings suggest a possible intestinal malrotation

candidates.name: Intussusception
support_spans: localized tenderness in the right lower abdomen and hypogastrium with a positive McBurney’s sign and rebound tenderness
candidates.why: The patient's abdominal pain and tenderness could be indicative of intussusception

candidates.name: Midgut volvulus
support_spans: an abnormal superior mesenteric artery–vein relationship, with the vein coursing to the left of the artery
candidates.why: The abnormal superior mesenteric artery-vein relationship suggests a possible midgut volvulus
